name: chrome-devtools-mcp
one_liner: Lets an AI coding assistant open and control a real Chrome browser, so it can click around, take screenshots, and debug web pages on its own.
buyer: A QA lead or dev agency wanting to automate browser testing and debugging with an AI agent.
business_use_cases: A QA team lets their AI agent reproduce and screenshot bugs automatically instead of manual repro steps.
An agency uses it so their AI coding assistant can visually verify a client's site renders correctly after every change.
A monitoring company builds automated visual-regression checks powered by an AI agent using this as the browser control layer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI-powered QA automation' service for small dev teams built on top of this MCP server.
Build and sell a hosted visual-regression testing product using it as the browser automation backend.

steal_this: Offer a $500/month 'AI QA on autopilot' service to small SaaS teams this week, using this to let an agent test their site after every deploy.
